essence: She is both intimately connected with and the dwelling place of stellar qualities.
The goddess embodies stellar supremacy and the power to save.
Tārā unites auspicious presence, mantra-form, ritual worship, and salvation.
Both her person and dwelling are depicted as radiant with stars.
Her bodily adornment is consistently described as stellar.
